==English==
{{wp|<dab!>}}

===Etymology===
* As an English surname, from the noun {{m|en|money}}. Compare {{m|en|Minter}}, {{m|en|Monier}}.
* As an {{der|en|ga|-}} surname, variant of {{m|en|Mooney}}.
* As a {{der|en|fr|-}} surname, variant of {{m|en|Monnet}}, itself a variant of {{m|en|Monet}}.

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun|~|s}}

# {{surname|en}}.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1991|author=Eli Coleman|title=John Money: A Tribute|page=xiv
|passage=This point highlights several of John '''Money''''s contributions to the field of behavioral science.}}
# {{place|en|ucomm|co/Leflore County|s/Mississippi|c/USA}}.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2021|author={{w|Percival Everett}}|title=[[w:The Trees (Everett novel)|The Trees]]|publisher=Influx Press (2022)|page=11|passage='''Money''', Mississippi, looks exactly like it sounds. Named in that persistent Southern tradition of irony and with the attendant tradition of nescience, the name becomes slightly sad, a marker of self-conscious ignorance that might as well be embraced because, let’s face it, it isn’t going away.}}
# {{place|en|ucomm|co/Gloucester County|s/Virginia|c/USA}}.

====Statistics====
* According to the 2010 United States Census, ''Money'' is the 5421<sup>st</sup> most common surname in the United States, belonging to 6420 individuals. ''Money'' is most common among White (84.78%) individuals.
